title: OXR dictator versus no-notables test
statement: For each real number $\delta$ with $0<\delta<1/8$, the test family obtained from the odd OXR sign tester with parameter $4\delta$ is a dictator-versus-no-notables test for the family of all input-negations of the three-input OXR predicate. Its parameters are $\alpha=3/4+2\delta$ and $\beta=1$, and its error function is the one determined by the degree chosen from $\delta$.
